title: Gonic
descript: Gonic is a music streaming server for your own library: it scans a folder of music, keeps a small database, and serves it to Subsonic-compatible clients (DSub, play:Sub, Symfonium, Airsonic clients...) with on-the-fly transcoding, playlists and podcast support. The music folder stays read-only; the database and cache live in the application data folder.
release_note: 1. First release: Gonic 0.23.0 from Docker Hub as a non-root container. Subsonic-compatible music server with scanning, transcoding, playlists and podcasts; database and cache in the application data folder.
important: Requires DockerEngine (installed automatically if missing). Put music into DockerAppData/gonicdocker/music, open the web UI and create the admin account; the scanner picks up new files on start and on schedule. The database, cache and playlists stay in DockerAppData/gonicdocker. Plain HTTP; use a TLS reverse proxy before exposing it to the internet.

wrapper_note:
the image listens on port 80 by default (which a non-root container cannot bind)
and refuses to start until its podcast folder exists. This wrapper creates the
missing folders and starts gonic on the published port.
wrapper_note_readme: - **Entrypoint wrapper**: creates the podcast/playlist folders and starts gonic on port 4747 with explicit `-music-path`, `-playlists-path`, `-cache-path` and `-db-path` arguments.

zh-hk.descript: Gonic 是自建音樂串流服務：掃描一個音樂目錄、維護一個小型資料庫，然後用 Subsonic 相容用戶端（DSub、play:Sub、Symfonium、Airsonic 用戶端等）播放，支援即時轉碼、播放清單與播客。音樂目錄唯讀，資料庫與快取保存在應用資料目錄。
zh-hk.important: 需要 DockerEngine（缺少時應用中心會自動安裝）。把音樂放進 DockerAppData/gonicdocker/music，開啟介面建立管理員帳號；掃描器會在啟動時和定時掃描新檔案。資料庫、快取與播放清單都在 DockerAppData/gonicdocker。介面為純 HTTP，公開到互聯網前請配置帶 TLS 的反向代理。
zh-hk.release_note: 1. 首個版本：基於 Docker Hub 的 Gonic 0.23.0，以非 root 容器運行。Subsonic 相容的音樂服務，支援掃描、轉碼、播放清單與播客；資料庫與快取保存在應用資料目錄。

data_notes: `/data` keeps `gonic.db` and podcasts; `/cache` keeps transcodes and cover art; `/playlists` keeps M3U playlists; `/music` (mounted from `.../music`) is the read-only library.
design_notes: **Port moved to 4747.** The image defaults to port 80, which uid 1000 cannot bind; the wrapper passes `-listen-addr`.
**Folders prepared up front.** Gonic refuses to start when the podcast folder is missing, so the wrapper creates it.
limitations: - Clients must speak the Subsonic API; there is no official mobile app.
- Scanning large libraries takes a while on first start.
- The UI is plain HTTP; use a TLS reverse proxy before exposing it to the internet.
